text: Centre foreground: a white digital balance with a blue-trimmed control panel and red LED display reading roughly "5.40". On its square white weighing pan sits a white plastic tube rack with two conical centrifuge tubes standing upright. The left tube is clear/translucent, capped with a white cap, and appears empty or holding a colourless liquid. The right tube has an orange cap and contains a teal/green liquid filling much of it. Behind the rack is a dark grey/black boxy instrument with a round port, resting on a metal-topped bench. Background: white wall panels, a black cable looping down at left, a blue vacuum pump with hose on the floor at right, and further pale equipment and cabinets.
